summary.text: Candace Calloway is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Chris Venable for a seat with no incumbent. A Detroit native, she works in construction for the city's General Services Department.

paragraphs.text: Candace Calloway said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she was born and raised on Detroit's west side, where she still lives.

She said she graduated from college in 2016 with a degree in Applied Health Sciences, served two years as an AmeriCorps member with City Year, and then worked as an academic interventionist with the Detroit Public Schools Community District.
She said she also worked at The Nature Conservancy on nature-based solutions to urban stormwater problems.
Calloway said she currently works in construction for the City of Detroit's General Services Department.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In the survey, she listed affordability and livable wages, full funding for education from pre-K through community college and trades training, and infrastructure and public transportation investment as her key messages.
